summary: A local Telluride man was reported overdue from a Sunday morning backcountry ski tour in the Base Camp area ~12 miles south of Telluride with his dog; the dog was found distressed at the Matterhorn Nordic parking lot; searchers located his body Monday Mar 4 just before 2pm in an avalanche ~100 ft wide x 800 ft long on the west side of Yellow Mountain.
location: Base Camp area, west side of Yellow Mountain, ~12 miles south of Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Search and Rescue, Telluride Ski Patrol and avalanche dogs, Telluride Helitrax, Mountain Blade Runner
notes: Skied Sunday Mar 3, 2019; body recovered Monday Mar 4; second avalanche death in two weeks in the region; victim unnamed in release.
